title: Mordecai Honored

questions.question: What happened to the king that night?
questions.explanation: Esther 6:1 (ESV): "On that night the king could not sleep..."

questions.question: What did the king order to be brought?
options: The book of memorable deeds, the chronicles
questions.correctAnswer: The book of memorable deeds, the chronicles
questions.explanation: Esther 6:1 (ESV): "...and he gave orders to bring the book of memorable deeds, the chronicles, and they were read before the king."

questions.question: Who was in the court when the king asked for advice?
questions.explanation: Esther 6:4 (ESV): "And the king said, 'Who is in the court?' Now Haman had just entered..."

questions.question: Who did Haman think the king wanted to honor?
questions.explanation: Esther 6:6 (ESV): "...And Haman thought to himself, 'Whom would the king delight to honor more than me?'"

questions.question: Who did the king command Haman to honor?
questions.explanation: Esther 6:10 (ESV): "...do so to Mordecai the Jew who sits at the king's gate..."

questions.question: What honors did Haman prescribe?
options: Royal robes, a royal horse, and a royal crown
questions.correctAnswer: Royal robes, a royal horse, and a royal crown
questions.explanation: Esther 6:8 (ESV): "...let royal robes be brought... and the horse that the king has ridden, and on whose head a royal crown is set."

questions.question: Where was the honored man to be led?
options: Through the square of the city
questions.correctAnswer: Through the square of the city
questions.explanation: Esther 6:9 (ESV): "...and let him lead him on the horse through the square of the city..."

questions.question: What was to be proclaimed before the honored man?
options: Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delights to honor
questions.correctAnswer: Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delights to honor
questions.explanation: Esther 6:9 (ESV): "...proclaiming before him: 'Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delights to honor.'"

questions.question: What did Mordecai do after the event?
questions.explanation: Esther 6:12 (ESV): "Then Mordecai returned to the king's gate..."

questions.question: What did Haman do after honoring Mordecai?
options: Hurried to his house mourning and with his head covered
questions.correctAnswer: Hurried to his house mourning and with his head covered
questions.explanation: Esther 6:12 (ESV): "...but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and with his head covered."

questions.question: Who advised Haman that he would fall before Mordecai?
options: His wise men and his wife Zeresh
questions.correctAnswer: His wise men and his wife Zeresh
questions.explanation: Esther 6:13 (ESV): "Then his wise men and his wife Zeresh said to him, 'If Mordecai... is of the Jewish people, you will not overcome him... but will surely fall before him.'"

questions.question: Why specifically did the king want to honor Mordecai?
options: Because nothing had been done for him for saving the king
questions.correctAnswer: Because nothing had been done for him for saving the king
questions.explanation: Esther 6:3 (ESV): "And the king said, 'What honor or distinction has been bestowed on Mordecai for this?' ... 'Nothing has been done for him.'"

questions.question: Who arrived while Haman was still talking to his friends?
questions.explanation: Esther 6:14 (ESV): "While they were yet talking with him, the king's eunuchs arrived..."

questions.question: Where did the eunuchs hurry to bring Haman?
options: To the feast that Esther had prepared
questions.correctAnswer: To the feast that Esther had prepared
questions.explanation: Esther 6:14 (ESV): "...and hurried to bring Haman to the feast that Esther had prepared."

questions.question: What detail about the horse did Haman specify?
options: The horse that the king has ridden, and on whose head a royal crown is set
questions.correctAnswer: The horse that the king has ridden, and on whose head a royal crown is set
questions.explanation: Esther 6:8 (ESV): "...and the horse that the king has ridden, and on whose head a royal crown is set."

key_verse_text: So Haman took the robes and the horse, and he dressed Mordecai and led him through the square of the city, proclaiming before him, “Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delights to honor.”
